name: php-8.4.15-trixie-amd64
notes: Official php:8.4.15-apache Docker image, Debian trixie. Offsets read from the image's own libphp.so. Verified RCE 2026-10-23: try 1, candidate 1, uid=33(www-data). ht_offset and staging params are identical to 8.4.26 - the heap layout after A1 did not change between these builds.
